name: signup
description: Notion signup chunk: opens the signup page, fills email, waits for the verification code (shared ImprovMX-based email chunk with Notion's extraction logic), submits it, waits for the redirect, then captures the session cookies (userId / token_v2 / deviceId). Ends here — use create-workspace / full-onboarding for the rest of the flow.

inputs.extractionJs: (args) => { try { if (args.manualCode) return { code: String(args.manualCode).trim(), source: 'manual' }; const data = JSON.parse(args.body); const logs = data.logs || []; const sinceMs = Math.max(0, (Number(args.sinceMs) || 0) - (Number(args.graceMs) || 120000)); const recipient = (args.email || '').toLowerCase(); let best = null; for (const log of logs) { const created = log.created || 0; if (sinceMs && created && created < sinceMs) continue; const to = ((log.recipient && log.recipient.email) || '').toLowerCase(); if (recipient && to && to !== recipient) continue; const subj = log.subject || ''; const sender = (log.sender && log.sender.email) || ''; if (!/notion/i.test(sender) && !/notion/i.test(subj)) continue; if (!best || created > best.created) best = { created, subject: subj, id: log.id }; } if (!best) return { code: null, reason: logs.length ? 'no Notion email newer than sinceMs for this recipient' : 'no emails yet', logCount: logs.length }; const subj = best.subject; const layers = [ /([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\s+is\s+(?:your|the)\s*(?:Notion\s*)?(?:login|verification|signup|pass)?\s*code/i, /(?:login|verification|signup|pass)\s*code(?:\s+is)?[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/i, /code[:\s]+([A-Za-z0-9]{4,10})\b/i ]; for (const re of layers) { const m = subj.match(re); if (m && /^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/.test(m[1])) return { code: m[1], source: 'notion-subject', subject: subj.slice(0, 100), logId: best.id }; } if (/(code|verify|verification|login|passcode|confirm|signup|otp|one[- ]?time)/i.test(subj)) { return { code: null, fatal: true, logId: best.id, subject: subj.slice(0, 100), error: 'The Notion verification email arrived ("' + subj.slice(0, 80) + '") but the code is NOT in the subject line — Notion puts it in the email body, and the ImprovMX inbox API only exposes subjects. Get the code from the forwarded mailbox (ansgareutychis@hotmail.com — check Junk), then run the notion/submit-code macro to type it into the still-open signup tab. (Or re-run signup with inputs.manualCode set — it skips polling.) Long-term fix: an email source that exposes bodies.' }; } return { code: null, reason: 'no code pattern in subject', subject: subj.slice(0, 100), logCount: logs.length }; } catch (e) { return { code: null, error: e.message }; } }

steps.function: const btns = document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"]'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.innerText.trim() === 'Continue') { b.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false };

(args) => { const t = (args.token || '').trim(); if (!t) return { ok: false, error: 'emailWorkerToken input is empty — set it in the popup config panel (Email API token)' }; if (/^(basic|bearer)\s+/i.test(t)) return { header: t }; try { return { header: 'Basic ' + btoa(t) }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: 'cannot build Authorization header (non-Latin1 token?): ' + e.message }; } }
const btns = document.querySelectorAll('div[role="button"]'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.innerText.trim() === 'Continue') { b.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false };

return new Promise((resolve) => { const check = () => { const url = window.location.href; if (url.includes('/onboarding') || (url.includes('app.notion.com') && !url.includes('/signup') && !url.includes('/login'))) { resolve({ redirected: true, url }); return; } setTimeout(check, 1000); }; check(); });

(args) => { const cookies = args.cookies || []; const map = {}; for (const c of cookies) map[c.name] = c.value; return { userId: map.notion_user_id || '', tokenV2: map.token_v2 || '', deviceId: map.notion_device_id || '' }; }

steps.message: 🎉 Signup complete — session captured. Run create-workspace / create-api-key next.
